title: Fleet syslog
description: Syslog from UEs and infrastructure, from Graylog's OpenSearch. Search and read messages in Graylog.

list.name: level
list.label: Severity
list.query: Error or worse : 3,Critical or worse : 2,Alert or worse : 1,Emergency : 0

panels.title: Critical or worse
panels.description: Messages at severity 0-2 (emergency, alert, critical) from any device, with the trend.

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Messages at severity 3 (error) from any device, with the trend.

panels.title: UEs at critical or worse
panels.description: Number of UEs that logged severity 0-2.

panels.title: UEs at the selected level
panels.description: Number of UEs that logged at the level chosen at the top (default: error or worse).

panels.title: Severity mix
panels.description: Share of messages per severity at the selected level.

panels.title: Messages by severity
panels.description: Count per 5-minute (or wider) interval at the selected level, stacked by severity.

panels.title: UEs reporting at the selected level
panels.description: Distinct UEs logging at the selected level per interval. Amber above 10, red above 25: many UEs at once points at a shared cause (LTE core, TAG, core switch), not one UE.

panels.title: Status by UE (worst severity per interval)
panels.description: The 30 UEs with the most messages at the selected level; each cell is the worst severity logged in that interval. A vertical band across many UEs = shared event (outage); a horizontal streak = one UE with an ongoing problem.

panels.title: UEs by severity
panels.description: Each UE's message count per severity at the selected level. Click a UE to open its messages in Graylog.

panels.title: Infrastructure by severity
panels.description: TAGs, core switches and other non-UE devices. Click a device to open it in Graylog.

panels.title: Top events
panels.description: Cisco event codes (FAC-SEV-MNEMONIC) at the selected level, with how many devices logged each.

panels.title: Latest critical-or-worse messages
panels.description: Most recent 500 messages at severity 0-2, newest first.
